title: The Temptation of Jesus and Early Ministry

questions.question: Who led Jesus up into the wilderness to be tempted by the devil?
options: He went of His own accord
questions.explanation: Matthew 4:1 (ESV): "Then Jesus was led up by the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted by the devil."

questions.question: How long did Jesus fast in the wilderness before the tempter came to Him?
questions.explanation: Matthew 4:2 (ESV): "And after fasting forty days and forty nights, he was hungry."

questions.question: What was the devil's first temptation to Jesus?
options: "If you are the Son of God, command these stones to become loaves of bread."
questions.correctAnswer: "If you are the Son of God, command these stones to become loaves of bread."
questions.explanation: Matthew 4:3 (ESV): "And the tempter came and said to him, 'If you are the Son of God, command these stones to become loaves of bread.'"

questions.question: How did Jesus respond to the first temptation?
options: "It is written, 'Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that comes from the mouth of God.'"
"I will not test the Lord my God."
"Bread is the provision of my Father."
questions.correctAnswer: "It is written, 'Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that comes from the mouth of God.'"
questions.explanation: Matthew 4:4 (ESV): "But he answered, 'It is written, "Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that comes from the mouth of God."'"

questions.question: For the second temptation, where did the devil take Jesus?
options: To the holy city and set him on the pinnacle of the temple
To the middle of the Dead Sea
questions.correctAnswer: To the holy city and set him on the pinnacle of the temple
questions.explanation: Matthew 4:5 (ESV): "Then the devil took him to the holy city and set him on the pinnacle of the temple"

questions.question: The devil quotes scripture during the second temptation saying, "He will command his angels concerning you...", which book is he quoting?
What was Jesus' response to the temptation on the pinnacle of the temple?
options: "Again it is written, 'You shall not put the Lord your God to the test.'"
"I am the Son of God, I need no angels."
questions.correctAnswer: "Again it is written, 'You shall not put the Lord your God to the test.'"
questions.explanation: Matthew 4:7 (ESV): "Jesus said to him, 'Again it is written, "You shall not put the Lord your God to the test."'"

questions.question: What did the devil show Jesus from an exceedingly high mountain during the third temptation?
options: All the kingdoms of the world and their glory
questions.correctAnswer: All the kingdoms of the world and their glory
questions.explanation: Matthew 4:8 (ESV): "Again, the devil took him to a very high mountain and showed him all the kingdoms of the world and their glory."

questions.question: What condition did the devil give Jesus to receive all the kingdoms of the world?
options: "If you will fall down and worship me."
"If you will turn these stones to gold."
"If you agree to share the throne."
questions.correctAnswer: "If you will fall down and worship me."
questions.explanation: Matthew 4:9 (ESV): "And he said to him, 'All these I will give you, if you will fall down and worship me.'"

questions.question: After Jesus commanded Satan to go away, who came and ministered to Him?
options: Angels came and were ministering to him
A widow from a nearby town brought food
questions.correctAnswer: Angels came and were ministering to him
questions.explanation: Matthew 4:11 (ESV): "Then the devil left him, and behold, angels came and were ministering to him."

questions.question: Why did Jesus withdraw into Galilee and settle in Capernaum by the sea?
options: He heard that John had been arrested
He wanted to become a fisherman
questions.correctAnswer: He heard that John had been arrested
questions.explanation: Matthew 4:12-13 (ESV): "Now when he heard that John had been arrested, he withdrew into Galilee. And leaving Nazareth he went and lived in Capernaum by the sea..."

questions.question: What was the consistent message Jesus began to preach, which was the same as John the Baptist's message?
options: "Repent, for the kingdom of heaven is at hand."
"The end of the age is upon us."
questions.correctAnswer: "Repent, for the kingdom of heaven is at hand."
questions.explanation: Matthew 4:17 (ESV): "From that time Jesus began to preach, saying, 'Repent, for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.'"

questions.question: Who were the first two brothers Jesus called while walking by the Sea of Galilee?
options: Simon (who is called Peter) and Andrew his brother
James and John, the sons of Zebedee
questions.correctAnswer: Simon (who is called Peter) and Andrew his brother
questions.explanation: Matthew 4:18 (ESV): "While walking by the Sea of Galilee, he saw two brothers, Simon (who is called Peter) and Andrew his brother, casting a net into the sea, for they were fishermen."

questions.question: What were James and John doing in the boat with their father Zebedee when Jesus called them?
questions.explanation: Matthew 4:21 (ESV): "And going on from there he saw two other brothers, James the son of Zebedee and John his brother, in the boat with Zebedee their father, mending their nets, and he called them."

questions.question: Jesus went throughout all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues and proclaiming the gospel of the kingdom and doing what else?
options: Healing every disease and every affliction among the people
Organizing an army to overthrow Rome
Writing letters to the high priest
questions.correctAnswer: Healing every disease and every affliction among the people
questions.explanation: Matthew 4:23 (ESV): "And he went throughout all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues and proclaiming the gospel of the kingdom and healing every disease and every affliction among the people."

key_verse_text: And he said to them, "Follow me, and I will make you fishers of men."
